summary.business_type: Publisher / YMYL health tool (calculator + editorial guides)
top_findings: public/favicon.png is a committed Vercel 503 timeout page served as image/png, referenced by rel=icon and WebSite.publisher.logo (regression)
Security headers absent: CSP, X-Content-Type-Options, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy, X-Frame-Options
Sitemap lastmod frozen at 2026-08-26 and sitemap generator not wired into build
Google Fonts render-blocking third-party CSS on all 16 pages
Initial JS payload ~398 KB gzipped (jsPDF + Recharts) = INP risk
quick_wins: Replace favicon.png with a real 32x32/180x180 icon set and add favicon.ico
Wire scripts/generate-sitemap.mjs into the build script
Set noindex on the 404 route and give it its own title

categories.name: Technical SEO
what_works: All 16 sitemap URLs return 200 with exact self-canonical and index,follow
16 unique titles and H1s; no noindex anywhere in src/
Sitemap valid and declared in robots.txt
HTTP to HTTPS single 308; HSTS max-age=63072000 includeSubDomains preload on every response
No redirect chain longer than 1 hop; no indexable parameter/case/dot-segment variants
0 images missing width/height across 16 pages (no CLS from images)
Module scripts + modulepreload; immutable caching on hashed assets

findings.title: public/favicon.png is a Vercel 503 error page served as image/png
findings.description: public/favicon.png is a committed 447-byte XHTML '503 first byte timeout' document served with Content-Type image/png. It is referenced by rel=icon and by WebSite.publisher.logo JSON-LD. /favicon.ico returns 404. This is a regression versus the 2026-08-26 audit, which recorded a 4 KB icon.
findings.recommendation: Replace public/favicon.png with a real rendered icon (32x32 PNG plus 180x180 apple-touch-icon), add a /favicon.ico, and verify WebSite.publisher.logo points at a valid logo image.

findings.title: Security response headers missing
findings.description: No Content-Security-Policy, X-Content-Type-Options, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy or X-Frame-Options on any response; no vercel.json in the repo to set them.
findings.recommendation: Add a vercel.json headers block setting X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff, Referrer-Policy: strict-origin-when-cross-origin, X-Frame-Options: DENY, a conservative Permissions-Policy, and a CSP appropriate for the TanStack Start build.

findings.title: Sitemap lastmod uniformly 2026-08-26 and generator not part of build
findings.description: Every sitemap entry reports lastmod 2026-08-26 although content shipped on 2026-08-27. scripts/generate-sitemap.mjs is not invoked by the build script, so public/sitemap.xml drifts whenever routes change.
findings.recommendation: Wire generate-sitemap.mjs into the build (or a prebuild step) and derive lastmod from actual content modification dates.

findings.title: Google Fonts render-blocking third-party CSS on all 16 pages
findings.description: Fonts load via third-party Google Fonts CSS plus 6 woff2 files (approx 299 KB), render-blocking on every route. Still open from the 2026-08-26 audit.
findings.recommendation: Self-host the font CSS and preconnect/preload the woff2 files, or system-font stack the critical path.

findings.title: Large initial JavaScript payload (INP risk)
findings.description: The homepage preloads a 257 KB gzipped chunk containing jsPDF (86 refs) and Recharts (74 refs); total initial JS is approximately 398 KB gzipped. Field INP is not measurable (no CrUX/PageSpeed credentials).
findings.recommendation: Code-split jsPDF (export/print) and Recharts (chart view) behind dynamic import so the calculator path ships neither.

findings.title: 404 route is indexable and inherits homepage metadata
findings.description: The 404 response returns status 404 but serves meta robots index,follow, no canonical, and the homepage title/og:url.
findings.recommendation: Serve a dedicated 404 title, keep the status 404, and add meta robots noindex to the not-found route.

findings.title: Case-variant URLs return 200
findings.description: Paths such as /About return 200 rather than 308 to the lowercase canonical. Canonical tags currently prevent duplicate indexing.
findings.recommendation: Normalise path case at the edge or route layer with a 308 to the canonical URL.

findings.title: Trailing-slash variants redirect with 307 instead of 308
findings.description: Trailing-slash variants answer 307 (cacheable temporary redirect) rather than 308 (permanent), so crawlers may re-evaluate them indefinitely.
findings.recommendation: Change trailing-slash redirects to 308.

findings.title: Service worker path 404s while the PWA registers it
findings.description: /sw.js returns 404 although src/pwa.ts registers it, so the visible 'Works offline' badge is not backed by a working offline path.
findings.recommendation: Ship the built service worker at /sw.js or remove the offline claim and the registration.

findings.title: www subdomain fails TLS with no redirect
findings.description: www.preemie.vercel.app has no valid certificate and no redirect to the apex host.
findings.recommendation: Add a certificate/redirect for www, or leave intentionally disabled and document it.

categories.name: Content Quality
what_works: Byline + dated review line on 16/16 pages, real physician headshot, Physician/sameAs/reviewedBy schema
Editorial policy, funding/COI policy, sitewide medical disclaimer, red-flag cross-links on 16/16
Internal linking strong (84): every page links forward into the calculator cluster
Answer-first 'Quick answers' blocks and a 7-question FAQ on the homepage

findings.title: No outbound citation links on 15 of 16 pages
findings.description: CDC/AAP/WHO/Fenton/INTERGROWTH appear as bare text only. The /methodology Sources table (Fenton PMID 23601190, INTERGROWTH, Zubler 2022) is plain text and unlinked, and JSON-LD carries no citation property. YMYL claims are therefore unverifiable from the page itself.
findings.recommendation: Link every named authority and each methodology source to its primary URL (target/PubMed/DOI) and add matching 'citation' entries to the MedicalWebPage/Article JSON-LD.

findings.title: Thin content: 11 of 16 pages under 800 words in <main>
findings.description: Median page is 630 words. /red-flags has 526 total words of which only 166 are prose; /how-to-calculate-corrected-age has 559; /nicu-follow-up-schedule 585. For a YMYL competitive query set this is below the depth peers publish.
findings.recommendation: Expand /red-flags, /how-to-calculate-corrected-age and /nicu-follow-up-schedule first with concrete worked examples, source-backed detail and unique first-hand clinical context; do not pad thin utility pages with filler.

findings.title: Readability below grade-8 target on 15 of 16 pages
findings.description: Median prose Flesch 46.8 (about grade 10). Worst: /nicu-follow-up-schedule 41.1, /preemie-vaccines 41.2, /about 42.3. Audience is anxious parents reading on mobile at night.
findings.recommendation: Shorten sentences and unpack clinical terms on the parent-facing pages; keep the clinician register on /pma-calculator and /methodology.

findings.title: Keyword cannibalization across calculator and comparison pages
findings.description: Cosine overlap: / vs /adjusted-age-calculator 0.64, / vs /pma-calculator 0.64; the age-comparison topic is spread over 4 pages (0.49-0.55); vaccines appear on 6 pages (0.52 vs /preemie-vaccines); stop-correcting covered by 4 pages.
findings.recommendation: Assign one canonical URL per query cluster, trim the overlapping sections on the secondary pages and point their internal links at the canonical - consolidate sections, do not delete pages.

findings.title: Titles and meta descriptions exceed recommended lengths
findings.description: 7 titles over 60 characters and 8 meta descriptions over 160 characters, risking SERP truncation; '| AdjustedAge' brand suffix is missing on /when-to-stop-correcting.
findings.recommendation: Rewrite the 7 titles and 8 descriptions to fit 50-60 / 150-160 characters with the primary keyword front-loaded and a consistent brand suffix.

findings.title: No direct contact or corrections channel
findings.description: Contact is described as 'via the about page' with no email/form, and there is no corrections log - both are trust signals Google's quality rater guidelines expect for YMYL health sites.
findings.recommendation: Publish a contact address or form on /about and add a dated corrections log.

findings.title: Milestone 'chart' has no tabular or downloadable artifact
findings.description: The page called a chart renders 72 list items; the whole site has only 3 <table> elements and no CSV/PDF download.
findings.recommendation: Render the milestones as a real table with a CSV/print export to match the 'chart' query intent and earn citations.

categories.name: On-Page SEO
what_works: 16/16 pages return 200 with exactly one H1, a self-referencing canonical, viewport meta and no heading-level skips
16/16 carry complete Open Graph (title, description, image, url, type) and Twitter card tags
256 internal links across 16 pages (avg 16/page) with descriptive anchor text into the calculator cluster
Every page has a unique title and unique meta description (no templates or duplicates detected)

findings.title: 7 titles exceed 60 characters
findings.description: Independent crawl of all 16 sitemap URLs found 7 titles over 60 characters, which Google will truncate in the SERP, hiding the brand suffix and possibly the primary keyword.
findings.recommendation: Cut each to 50-60 characters, front-loading the primary keyword and keeping '| AdjustedAge' at the end.

findings.title: 8 meta descriptions exceed 160 characters and 1 is short
findings.description: 8 descriptions run past 160 characters (truncated mid-sentence in SERPs) and 1 is under 120 characters, wasting the click-through opportunity.
findings.recommendation: Rewrite to 150-160 characters opening with the answer, not a restatement of the title, and closing on a concrete benefit rather than a stock CTA.

findings.title: Brand suffix missing on /when-to-stop-correcting
findings.description: The only title in the set without the '| AdjustedAge' suffix, breaking brand consistency in SERPs and OG previews.
findings.recommendation: Restore the suffix to match the other 15 titles.

findings.title: Thinnest page carries only 599 words
findings.description: Minimum word count across the 16 URLs is 599 (median 859), so at least one page sits under the depth expected for its query class.
findings.recommendation: Identify the sub-600-word page in onpage.json and expand it with source-backed, unique content.

categories.name: AI Search Readiness
what_works: Every major AI crawler (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, Claude-Web, PerplexityBot, Google-Extended, CCBot, bingbot, msnbot, OAI-SearchBot) receives 200 with a byte-identical 55,643-byte body - no blocking, no cloaking, no X-Robots-Tag
robots.txt permissive (Allow: /) with sitemap declared; only /mcp, /.mcp/, /.well-known/, /~oauth/ disallowed
llm.txt and llms.txt both live and byte-identical (4,088 B), covering 16/16 sitemap URLs
Answer-first structure: 'Quick answers' / 'The short answer' blocks, 7-question FAQ, Physician + reviewedBy + sameAs graph on every page, datePublished/dateModified/lastReviewed, true SSR
Brand consistency: AdjustedAge + preemie.vercel.app identical across og:url, canonical and site_name on 16/16 pages

findings.title: llms.txt entries are not links and not absolute URLs
findings.description: Entries are formatted as '**/path** - description' rather than markdown links with absolute URLs, so link-extracting AI parsers recover zero URLs from the file.
findings.recommendation: Regenerate llms.txt with '[Title](https://preemie.vercel.app/path)' link syntax for all 16 pages.

findings.title: Zero outbound source links citable by AI systems
findings.description: Authority sources are named as plain text only across all 16 pages, so an answer engine extracting claims cannot cite a verifiable source from this site. Same root cause as the content-side citation gap.
findings.recommendation: Add primary-source links to CDC/AAP/WHO/Fenton/INTERGROWTH references and mirror them in JSON-LD 'citation'.

findings.title: Article schema missing reviewedBy and lastReviewed on two spoke pages
findings.description: /premature-baby-milestones and /how-to-calculate-corrected-age carry Article schema without reviewedBy/lastReviewed, unlike the rest of the site.
findings.recommendation: Add reviewedBy (Physician @id) and lastReviewed dates to match the site-wide pattern.

findings.title: Organization.logo points at the broken 447-byte favicon
findings.description: Organization.logo still references the invalid favicon asset identified in the technical pass, weakening entity recognition.
findings.recommendation: Point Organization.logo at a real 1148x1148 (or larger) logo image and keep it referenced by ImageObject.

findings.title: Title brand drift on one page
findings.description: /when-to-stop-correcting omits the AdjustedAge brand suffix present on the other 15 titles.
findings.recommendation: Restore the consistent '| AdjustedAge' suffix.

notes: Google API credentials not configured: no CrUX field CWV, no GSC indexation status, no GA4 traffic (seo-google agent not spawned).
Moz/Bing/Keywords Everywhere keys not configured: backlink tier is Common Crawl only (0 cached domains at audit time).
No prior drift baseline existed; one is being captured during this audit so future runs can compare.
PageSpeed Insights returned rate-limited during the technical pass; lab evidence is structural (HTML/JS/CSS analysis), not field data.
